design_philosophy: Institutional, functional, high-density 'Control Room' design. Emphasizing data clarity, objective metrics, and strict hierarchy over decorative elements.

typography.heading_strategy: Tight tracking, radical weight contrast (Black vs Light). Do not exceed text-5xl for main headings.
typography.body_strategy: Clean, legible, left-aligned, text-sm for data density.

spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: Control Room Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4), tight gap-4. Every pixel utilized. h-full on children.
spacing_and_layout.container_padding: p-4 or p-6 for bento boxes. Data density is key.

components.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (#222222), no shadow. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-px) and border color darkens.
components.buttons: Solid functional colors or stark white-on-black ghost buttons. Sharp corners.
components.tables: Shadcn highly customized. No alternating row colors, just thin 1px bottom border (#222222). Hover effect on rows. IBM Plex Mono for numeric columns.
components.inputs: Solid dark background, 1px border (#222222), white text, focus ring is primary blue.
components.navigation: Sidebar or top nav with Solid Background (not glass) to keep it technical. Environment switcher (Sandbox/Prod) as a high-contrast pill.
components.modals: Approval workflow modals must use stark contrast for the action buttons. Dimmed backdrop (bg-black/80).

motion.transitions: Instant or very fast (0.15s ease). No bouncy or slow animations. Institutional tools feel snappy.
motion.hover_states: Visible but subtle background color shift (surface to surface_hover). Text color remains high contrast.

assets.icons: Phosphor Icons (dense, clear, thin lines). Provide installation command: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react

image_urls.description: Abstract dark geometric texture for login background

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a dual-surface platform (Backoffice and Client Portal). Start with the shared layout shell (Sidebar, Header with Environment Switcher). Use Shadcn but customize it aggressively to match the 'Technical/Swiss Brutalist' dark theme: replace border-radius with 'rounded-sm', replace 'bg-background' with deep #050505, and use 1px borders everywhere to create a 'Control Room' grid. Tables and numeric data must use 'font-mono' (IBM Plex Mono). Make sure to include data-testid attributes on all interactive elements. Avoid 'Inter' font. Sandbox badge should be Warning Yellow, Prod should be Green or Neutral. REMEMBER: Provide implementation guidelines for .js files NOT .tsx files (e.g., use JSX in .js files, no TypeScript interfaces). DO NOT use generic placeholders for missing logos; use the provided partner_logo image URLs in the assets object.
